prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with bright red hair wearing a gray and black striped long-sleeve top and black pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07"].

message.content: {"matches":["P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P04 has bright red hair and is wearing a gray and black striped long-sleeve top with black pants, matching all described appearance features. No other person in the image set has bright red hair."}

parsed.reason: P04 has bright red hair and is wearing a gray and black striped long-sleeve top with black pants, matching all described appearance features. No other person in the image set has bright red hair.
